description: This file contains unit tests for DataElement and related classes in the WPEFramework Core namespace, using Google Test framework. It tests data copying, CRC calculation, buffer manipulation, linked data elements, and data parsing functionalities.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Represents a data element with buffer management, CRC, search, and set/get functionalities.

classes.name: DataStore
classes.description: Manages a buffer with copy, size, and buffer access methods.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Represents a linked data element that can be enclosed and linked with other data elements.

classes.name: DataElementParser
classes.description: Parses a DataElement, providing size, validity, and byte skipping functionalities.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data into the DataStore or DataElement.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Gets or sets the size of the DataStore or DataElement buffer.

methods.name: Buffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the buffer managed by DataStore or DataElement.

methods.name: CRC32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a specified range.

methods.name: SearchNumber
methods.description: Searches for a number in the DataElement buffer with specified endianness.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a number at a specified position in the DataElement buffer.

methods.name: GetNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a number from the DataElement buffer at a specified position.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for a sequence of bytes within the DataElement.

methods.name: SetBitNumber
methods.description: Sets bits within a number at a specified position.

methods.name: GetBitNumber
methods.description: Retrieves bits within a number at a specified position.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a value at a specific offset in the DataElement.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns the DataElement buffer to a specified boundary.

methods.name: SetBuffer
methods.description: Sets the buffer range for a linked data element.

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the buffer range from a linked data element.

methods.name: LinkedSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the linked data.

methods.name: LinkedElements
methods.description: Returns the number of linked elements.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the DataElement is valid.

methods.name: SkipBytes
methods.description: Skips a number of bytes in the parser.
